description: List the routes on one SIP trunk, by `integrationId` (from listCarrierIntegrations), sorted by name: routeId, name, techPrefix, custom headers, enabled and dialable. A test config uses a routeId as its carrierRouteId. Use when: the user asks which routes a trunk has or whether one can be dialled. Read-only. Needs testing:read. Returns 404 if the trunk is not in your workspace.
name: listCarrierRoutes

routes.description: Sorted by name. Empty for an integration with no routes yet.

items.description:
One vendor reached through a carrier integration, selected by its tech prefix. Put its
`routeId` on a test config as `carrierRouteId` to dial through it.

customHeaders.description: `X-` headers sent on the INVITE, for SBCs that route on a header.

dialable.description:
Whether a run naming this route would be placed now: the route is enabled and its
integration is `active`. Offer only these in a picker. It is checked again when a
run starts.

techPrefix.description:
Dialled in front of the destination number (`sip:{techPrefix}{e164}@{host}:{port}`).
Empty means the trunk's default route.

title: List Carrier Routes
